cohort: 60 full-term pregnant women with singleton uncomplicated pregnancies, ASA class 1 or 2, scheduled for elective caesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Leg wrapping with elastic crepe bandage just before subarachnoid block significantly decreased the incidence of spinal hypotension and reduced the use of vasopressor agents compared to leg elevation.
followup_time: During and shortly after surgery (up to 14 minutes)
